questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f'(x)\ln f(y)\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f'(0)\ln f(0)=0\\&\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f(x)\cdot\frac{f'(y)}{f(y)}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f(0)\frac{f'(0)}{f(0)}=0\\&A=\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x^2}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f''(x)\ln f(y)\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f''(0)\ln f(0)>0\\&B=\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f'(x)\cdot\frac{f'(y)}{f(y)}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=\frac{f'^2(0)}{f(0)}=0\\&C=\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial y^2}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f(x)\cdot\frac{f(y)f''(y)-f'^2(y)}{f^2(y)}\Bigg|_{(0,0)}=f''(0)>0\\&\text{则}\,\,\,A\,C-B^2>0\,.\end{aligned}
